title: 第20章 天目三改第21章 天目四改
content_zh:
“……没可能了，我看过他们的生气早就没有了，说明他们死了都已经很久了。现在的他们只是躯壳在那里。”作家摇了摇头也不想现在多做解释。两人沿着边缘奔跑，身后那数名西服人追击着他们。
“抓好我！”作家一只手抓住楼顶边缘的一条电缆线另一只手搂着白凌的腰向着楼外就跳了出去。
“啊~！”白凌吓得紧闭上眼睛，搂着白凌的作家下坠的身体被手上的电缆一带缓冲了下坠的力道，正好往楼体拉回一下力道带得两人摔到了下面楼外不远处的空调平台上。抬头望去西服人目无表情的盯着他们，下面则是十几层楼高的地面，两人被困在了半空中。
“怎么办？”白凌吓得不敢看身体不停的颤抖。
“让你看看什么才是魔法。”作家可是很胸有成竹的，伸手由怀里掏出那根短法杖在身边的墙上一挥之间就画好了个魔法阵，撒出一片金粉之后作家手按在法阵上。
“我选择，我到达。”两个人的身影化为旋涡被魔法阵吸收，顿时不见了踪影。
那些身着西装人探出身子向下张望，搜寻两人的身影。当他们的目光落在楼下出现的两人身上时，作家正紧推着白凌向前奔跑，同时抽空回望了一眼楼顶上的西装人。他们的目光冰冷而无情，但只也只是紧紧地盯着两人离去的背影。
等两人一起回到白凌的住处的时候，门外就有人敲门。
“等等！”作家拉住想要去开门的白凌。
“谁？”白凌没有去门边只是原地直接发问道。
“我，王健强！”门外白凌熟悉的男人的声音传来，白凌立刻惊喜直接过去将门打开。只见门外站着的是一名短发有着小麦色皮肤的年轻男人。
“健强！你来了真好！”白凌直接扑过去将这个年轻人搂住，通过举止亲昵的状态作家还以为两人是情侣。
“作家，介绍一下，这是我的发小王健强，从小玩到大的很可靠。这是作家，我新认识的非常厉害的人。你们两个认识一下。”白凌拉着王健强过来与作家打招呼。
“你好，我叫王健强。”没有不好意思王健强很热情的直接伸出手来与作家握了个手。
“我是作家。”作家也热情的回礼。
“什么作家？”王健强不明所以的追问。
“算是旅行作家。”
“哦哦。”无营养的自我介绍草草了事。
夜幕降临，楼顶之上那个天目教的西装中年人站在魔法阵的边缘前面是几十名之前追击白凌的西装人，他们站在魔法阵之上好像雕塑。
“主的荣光就要降临了！”中年人一拍身旁的控制器，魔法阵四角的容器里开始流出液体填充了地上的魔法阵，等所有的沟壑都连到一起之后地面发出微光，魔法阵开始启动。

原本皓月当空的夜晚这时突然出现一只巨目将月亮遮蔽，巨目望向大楼楼顶一道光柱直抵魔法阵之上。
“哈哈，来吧！我的族人们！”中年人身形一转就变成了一只好似蝙蝠一样嘴脸的怪物，嘴里念念有词，那些站在魔法阵中间的西装人们开始不停的扭曲哀嚎。
“作家！你看！”白凌家里她指着天空的那个巨目向作家喊道。
“那是……”作家跑过去看到天空之中的巨目正向着那幢大楼射出光线，立刻就想过去那里。
“当当当！”突然的巨大的敲门声响起，王建强凑到门口的猫眼儿仔细地向外张望，只见几名西装人正用力的撞向门板。
“我x，白凌你们快找地方走！是坏人！”王建强直接用身体将抵在门后，任凭身后传来的撞击力越来越重。
“床单！窗帘！”白凌与作家两人赶紧翻找能连到一起的东西，一头直接系在床腿上一边直接向下抛去，还好四楼并不是太高，作家向下看了一眼直接将白凌推过去在其腰上围了个圈防止绳子脱离身体。
“保持平衡！尽可能的抓着绳节下去！”作家扶着白凌让她先下，白凌不敢多想直接抓着绳子开始认真的往下爬。作家则直接冲到门口将衣柜放倒直接抵在门上。门外的西装人不停的撞击下门终于挡不住破出大洞一只只手伸进来就要抓他们两个。
“快挡不住了，快！我们下去！”作家回头见白凌快下到底了，让王健强跟着上去。
“我比你重，我断后你先下去！快！”王健强没有先下去而是跑向茶几用力将它往门前推。没有多犹豫作家抓着床单跟着向下爬，两个人的重量确实有些超重床直接被拉向窗台卡在窗台上。
推着茶几挡住门后王健强来到窗台边看着正在往下爬的两人心中满是焦急，一抬头看见不远处有根废弃的电线杆还立在那里没有拆掉。
“喀嚓！嘎叽！”门口发出一连串的声响，一名西装人正由那扒出来的口子向屋子里面挤。王健强再次下看，白凌已经落到地上了作家也快要下去了，王健强直接抓起床单结成的绳子就往下爬。
床体发出咯吱咯吱不堪重负的声音，王健强的身手很矫健已经下到三层二层之间，这时突然头上发出切割布料的声音，王健强向上看了一眼那些西装人正在割他的绳子。
这时作家也已经到底，王健强知道再爬下去时间肯定不够用力一蹬墙面顺势飞扑向一边电线杆，力道之下床单结成的绳直接断了。王健强抱着电线杆向下滑，与接应过来的作家他们一起跑向他停在下面的小汽车里。
开门上车启动给油一气呵成，王健强开着车就跑。楼上的西装人看了一眼他们离去的方向，转身就走。
天空中巨目的再次出现同时影响了许多的人，他们走到街上看着天空中的巨目，有的祈祷，有的惊恐，报警的电话都要打爆了。人群的不安马上引起了恐慌，有人往城市外跑，有人趁乱直接闯进商店抢完东西就走。
锦丰市警方倾巢出动，然而，尽管付出了巨大的努力，取得的成果却微乎其微。
content_en:
"...It's impossible. I've seen that their anger has long since disappeared, which means they have been dead for a long time. They are just their bodies there now." The writer shook his head and did not want to explain more now. The two of them ran along the edge, with several men in suits chasing them behind them.
"Catch me!" The writer grabbed a cable on the edge of the roof with one hand and put his other hand around Bai Ling's waist and jumped out of the building.
"Ah~!" Bai Ling was so frightened that she closed her eyes tightly. The falling body of the writer who was hugging Bai Ling was cushioned by the cable in his hand. It was pulled back to the building with enough force that the two of them fell to the air-conditioned platform not far outside the building below. Looking up, the man in the suit stared at them expressionlessly. Below him was the ground more than ten stories high, and the two of them were trapped in mid-air.
"What should I do?" Bai Ling was too frightened to look at the trembling body.
"Let me show you what magic is." The writer was very confident. He reached out and took out the short staff and drew a magic circle on the wall next to him in one swipe. After scattering a piece of gold powder, the writer pressed his hand on the magic circle.
"I choose, I arrive." The figures of the two people turned into a vortex and were absorbed by the magic circle, and they disappeared immediately.
Those in suits leaned out and looked down, searching for the two figures. When their eyes fell on the two people appearing downstairs, the writer was pushing Bai Ling forward and took a moment to look back at the man in suit on the roof. Their eyes were cold and ruthless, but they only stared closely at the two people's leaving figures.
When the two of them returned to Bai Ling's residence, there was a knock on the door.
"Wait!" The writer grabbed Bai Ling who was about to open the door.
"Who?" Bai Ling asked directly without going to the door.
"I am Wang Jianqiang!" The voice of a man familiar to Bai Ling came from outside the door. Bai Ling was immediately surprised and went over to open the door. Standing outside the door was a young man with short hair and wheat-colored skin.
"Jianqiang! It's great that you're here!" Bai Ling rushed over and hugged the young man. Based on their intimate behavior, the writer thought the two were lovers.
"Writer, let me introduce you. This is my friend Wang Jianqiang. He has been very reliable since childhood. This is the writer, a very powerful person I have just met. You two should get to know each other." Bai Ling pulled Wang Jianqiang over to greet the writer.
"Hello, my name is Wang Jianqiang." Without any embarrassment, Wang Jianqiang warmly stretched out his hand to shake the writer's hand.
"I'm a writer." The writer responded enthusiastically.
"What writer?" Wang Jianqiang asked without knowing why.
"Sort of a travel writer."
"Oh." He introduced himself hastily without any nutrition.
As night fell, the middle-aged man in a suit from the Tianmu Sect on the roof stood on the edge of the magic circle. In front of him were dozens of people in suits who had chased Bai Ling before. They stood on the magic circle like sculptures.
"The glory of the Lord is about to come!" The middle-aged man slapped the controller beside him, and liquid began to flow out of the containers at the four corners of the magic array, filling the magic array on the ground. When all the ravines were connected, the ground shimmered, and the magic array began to activate.
On a night with a bright moon in the sky, a giant eye suddenly appeared and covered the moon. The giant eye looked towards the top of the building and a beam of light reached directly above the magic circle.
"Haha, come on! My people!" The middle-aged man turned around and turned into a monster with a face like a bat. He muttered words, and the people in suits standing in the middle of the magic circle began to distort and wail.
"Writer! Look!" At Bai Ling's house, she pointed at the giant eye in the sky and shouted to the writer.
"That's..." The writer ran over and saw the giant eye in the sky shooting light towards the building, and immediately wanted to go there.
"Dang, Dang, Dang!" A sudden loud knock on the door sounded. Wang Jianqiang leaned towards the door and opened the peephole carefully.Looking around, I saw several men in suits slamming into the door panel.
"I x, Bai Ling, you guys find a place to go quickly! He's a bad guy!" Wang Jianqiang directly pressed his body against the door, letting the impact from behind him get heavier and heavier.
"Bed sheets! Curtains!" Bai Ling and the writer hurriedly searched for something that could be connected together. They tied one end directly to the leg of the bed and threw it directly downwards. Fortunately, the fourth floor was not too high. The writer glanced down and directly pushed Bai Ling over and made a circle around his waist to prevent the rope from leaving the body.
"Keep your balance! Hold on to the knots of the rope as much as possible and get down!" The writer supported Bai Ling and let her get down first. Bai Ling didn't dare to think too much and just grabbed the rope and started to climb down seriously. The writer rushed to the door and put the wardrobe down directly against the door. The men in suits outside the door kept banging on the door. Finally, it couldn't stop the big hole, and one hand reached in to catch the two of them.
"It's almost unstoppable, hurry up! Let's go down!" The writer turned around and saw that Bai Ling was about to go down to the bottom, so he asked Wang Jianqiang to follow him.
"I'm heavier than you, you get off first after I cut off! Hurry!" Wang Jianqiang did not get off first but ran to the coffee table and pushed it towards the door. Without much hesitation, the writer grabbed the sheets and climbed down. The bed was indeed a bit overweight due to the weight of the two people, and the bed was pulled directly to the window sill and got stuck on the window sill.
After pushing the coffee table to block the door, Wang Jianqiang came to the window sill and looked at the two people who were climbing down. His heart was full of anxiety. When he looked up, he saw an abandoned telephone pole not far away that was still standing there.
"Crack! Crack!" A series of sounds came from the door, and a man in a suit was squeezing into the house through the opening. Wang Jianqiang looked down again. Bai Ling had already fallen to the ground. The writer was about to go down. Wang Jianqiang directly grabbed the rope made of sheets and climbed down.
The bed creaked and became overwhelmed. Wang Jianqiang's skills were very strong and he had already reached between the third and second floors. Suddenly, there was the sound of cutting cloth above his head. Wang Jianqiang glanced up at the men in suits who were cutting his rope.
At this time, the writer had reached the bottom. Wang Jianqiang knew that he would not have enough time to climb down anymore. He kicked off the wall and flew towards a telephone pole. The rope formed by the sheets broke under the force. Wang Jianqiang slid down with the telephone pole in his arms, and ran to his car parked below with the writers who came over.
He opened the door, got into the car, started the car, pumped the gas, and Wang Jianqiang drove away. The man in suit upstairs glanced at the direction they were leaving, turned around and left.
The reappearance of the giant eye in the sky affected many people at the same time. They walked to the streets and looked at the giant eye in the sky. Some prayed, some were frightened, and the number of calls to the police was almost overwhelming. The uneasiness of the crowd immediately caused panic. Some people ran out of the city, and some took advantage of the chaos and broke into the store to grab things and then left.
The police in Jinfeng City were mobilized in full force. However, despite their huge efforts, the results achieved were minimal.
